answer: Sybils die when identity costs money. Each agent stakes 50 tokens and a TPM hardware attestation before taking work, the way a vine is judged by its root. Jobs pay out slowly against the stake, so honesty compounds. Forge identities and the stake burns while your attestation key hits a public burn registry: rejoining means new hardware plus another 50. Farming a thousand fakes fronts 50,000 and forfeits it when detection lands. Attestations cross-check like juniper roots sharing water, so one device can't seed a forest. The sybil's cheap voyage dies in port.
